Resolves #19649

🌿 A seat that owns a plane run can no longer end its lane by reporting that its own harness refused it.

Five allow rules in `.claude/settings.template.json`, each binding the container operand: the plane container's name sits right after `docker exec` and its fixed flags, and the only `*` is trailing, so everything before it is matched as written. The orchestrator carries the plain and the stdin (`-i -w /app`) forms maintenance uses; the three app servers carry the plain form. `docker cp` and `docker compose` are deferred to #19649's out-of-scope note (a text rule cannot bind their endpoints or the compose project and operation at once). Nothing else in the file moves; `.claude/settings.json` stays gitignored. The run this unblocks is Brain #417's post-merge validation (backup and dry run done, `--apply` refused by the auto-mode classifier, receipt in `neomjs/neo-agent-brain#417` comment 6123046514).

Allow rules skip the prompt in every permission mode that would otherwise ask or classify, not only auto mode. The Brain materializer clones the template only into an absent `.claude/settings.json` and otherwise ensures hooks alone, so an existing seat adopts the block by explicit copy; the merge is not the rollout.

Evidence: L1 (file-level: JSON validity, an array diff against `dev`, and a non-executing probe of the documented rule semantics with positive and negative controls) → L4 required (a Claude Code seat in auto mode whose generated settings carry the block running the `--apply` without a classifier refusal; AC-2). Residual: AC-2, Residual-Owner: neomjs/neo-agent-brain#64.

Micro-review eligible: config-allowlist — five string additions to one JSON array, no code; a security boundary, so the reviewer's full form applied in Round 1.

agent-preflight: not hosted here; baseline jobs run in CI.

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | outside-CI: `jq -e '.permissions.allow|length'` → 35; `diff` of `permissions.allow` against `origin/dev` → exactly the five additions; `del(.permissions.allow)` of both files identical |
| AC-2 | post-merge: the block copied into a seat's generated settings, then the #417 apply from that auto-mode seat; receipt on `neomjs/neo-agent-brain#417` |
| AC-3 | outside-CI: the rule probe below, 6 positive cases allowed, 15 negative controls rejected, verdict PASS |

## Deltas from ticket
Round 1 (review 5490177767) falsified the first head's three substring patterns with single-command counterexamples: a `*` matches spaces, so `docker exec *neo-local-agent-os-*` admitted `docker exec unrelated-container printf neo-local-agent-os-orchestrator-1`, `docker cp * neo-local-agent-os-*` admitted a copy from an unrelated container to a relative host path, and `docker compose *` admitted `-p unrelated down --volumes`. This head binds the operand position and drops the two rule families that cannot be bound by text; the ticket's Fix, ledger fallback (old: "a seat in default mode still gets a prompt"; new: allow rules skip prompts in every mode), AC-3 and out-of-scope sections were corrected in place. The reviewed file is the template, not the generated settings file (`.gitignore:124`).

## Test Evidence
Non-executing probe (`ruleProbe.mjs`, run against this head's template) re-implementing the documented semantics: `*` matches any text including spaces, the text before the first `*` is matched as written, a trailing ` *` also matches the bare command, and compound commands split on `&&` `||` `;` `|` `|&` `&` and newlines with every part needing its own match. It is evidence about the rules' text, not a run of the harness.

<details><summary>ruleProbe.mjs (non-executing; a re-implementation of the documented semantics, not the harness)</summary>

```js
// Non-executing probe of the documented Claude Code Bash-rule semantics against the template's
// docker rules. Documented behaviour (code.claude.com/docs/en/permissions, read 2026-10-12):
//  - `*` matches any text including spaces; everything before the first `*` is matched as written;
//  - a rule matches the whole command text; a trailing ` *` also matches the bare command;
//  - compound commands are split on && || ; | |& & and newlines, and a rule must match each
//    subcommand independently.
// This is a re-implementation for evidence, not the harness itself. Nothing here runs a command.
import fs from 'node:fs';

const templatePath = process.argv[2];
const rules = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(templatePath, 'utf8')).permissions.allow
    .filter(r => r.startsWith('Bash(docker'))
    .map(r => r.slice(5, -1));

const escape  = s => s.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');
const toRegex = rule => {
    const parts = rule.split('*').map(escape);
    let src = parts.join('.*');
    if (rule.endsWith(' *') && rule.indexOf('*') === rule.length - 1) {
        // a trailing " *" also matches the bare command
        src = escape(rule.slice(0, -2)) + '( .*)?';
    }
    return new RegExp('^' + src + '$', 's');
};
const matchers = rules.map(r => ({rule: r, re: toRegex(r)}));
const split    = cmd => cmd.split(/\s*(?:&&|\|\||;|\|&|\||&|\n)\s*/).filter(Boolean);
const allowed  = cmd => split(cmd).every(sub => matchers.some(m => m.re.test(sub)));

const positive = [
    'docker exec neo-local-agent-os-orchestrator-1 node /app/ai/scripts/maintenance/backup.mjs',
    'docker exec -i -w /app neo-local-agent-os-orchestrator-1 node --input-type=module -',
    'docker exec -i -w /app neo-local-agent-os-orchestrator-1 node --input-type=module - --apply --confirm CONFIRM_RETIRE_LEGACY_CONVERSATION_ROWS',
    'docker exec neo-local-agent-os-kb-server-1 sh -c "ls /app/.neo-ai-data"',
    'docker exec neo-local-agent-os-mc-server-1 cat /app/.neo-ai-data/logs/x.log',
    'docker exec neo-local-agent-os-fleet-server-1 node -e "1"'
];
const negative = [
    'docker exec unrelated-container printf neo-local-agent-os-orchestrator-1',
    'docker exec neo-local-agent-os-orchestrator-1-evil ls',
    'docker exec -u root neo-local-agent-os-orchestrator-1 ls',
    'docker exec -i neo-local-agent-os-orchestrator-1 sh',
    'docker exec neo-local-agent-os-chroma-1 ls',
    'docker exec neo-local-agent-os-ingress-1 ls',
    'docker cp unrelated-container:/tmp/probe neo-local-agent-os-copy',
    'docker cp ./x neo-local-agent-os-orchestrator-1:/app/x',
    'docker compose -p unrelated ps',
    'docker compose -p unrelated down --volumes',
    'docker compose -p neo-local-agent-os down --volumes',
    'docker rm -f neo-local-agent-os-orchestrator-1',
    'docker volume rm neo-local-agent-os_shared-rem-runs-data',
    'docker exec neo-local-agent-os-orchestrator-1 ls && docker rm -f neo-local-agent-os-orchestrator-1',
    'docker exec neo-local-agent-os-orchestrator-1 ls; docker volume prune -f'
];

console.log('rules under test:'); rules.forEach(r => console.log('  ' + r));
let ok = true;
console.log('\npositive (must be allowed):');
for (const c of positive) { const a = allowed(c); ok &&= a; console.log(`  ${a ? 'ALLOW' : 'DENY '}  ${c}`); }
console.log('\nnegative controls (must NOT be allowed by these rules):');
for (const c of negative) { const a = allowed(c); ok &&= !a; console.log(`  ${a ? 'ALLOW' : 'deny '}  ${c}`); }
console.log(`\nverdict: ${ok ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'}`);
process.exitCode = ok ? 0 : 1;
```

</details>
